en: Enable live follow-up messages for Claude and Grok in the same running native conversation, removing the Codex-only restriction. The CLI may process guidance after the current generation or tool step.
Keep native input connections open while follow-ups are pending, confirm delivery and retain uncertain sends for review.
Process live guidance independently across conversations so one provider awaiting acknowledgment does not block another.
zh: 接通 Claude 和 Grok 运行中原生会话的补充消息，取消实时引导仅限 Codex 的限制；CLI 可能在当前生成或工具步骤结束后处理。
补充消息待处理时保持原生输入连接，确认送达；无法确认的消息保留等待核对。
各会话独立处理实时引导，一个入口等待确认不会阻塞其他会话。
